This costume seemed fitting https://t.co/GSGMiFqMIA
blurb: A wiener dog named Gary, dressed as Gary the snail: pink spiral shell on his back, googly-eyed stalks on his head. He's holding his snout high and wearing the whole thing with remarkable dignity.
